title: refuses a named_absent text that is carried
why: A named_absent entry no longer held to being absent: once the archive carries the text, the reason recorded for owing nothing stays in the pins unread, and the new release passes without anyone rereading the list.

title: still carries Tcl/Tk
why: The guard on the strip gone: a runtime vendored without the strip, or from a release that lays Tcl/Tk out under other names, ships its libraries and Windows' zlib1.dll again, code the app never loads under advisories nothing watches.

title: refuses a runtime that still carries Tcl/Tk
why: Windows' zlib1.dll let through: it is the one file of the strip that is not named for Tcl or Tk, and the zlib OSV reports advisories against.

title: refuses a runtime that still carries Tcl/Tk
why: The vendor job's check no longer asks about Tcl/Tk: --packages is the one check vendor-python.sh makes after the strip, so a strip that missed something would be found only at packaging, after the artefact was uploaded.
